We pride ourselves on reliability, integrity, and exceptional customer service—while creating meaningful employment opportunities for veterans.</p> <p><strong>This Is Not a Typical Customer Service Role</strong></p> <p>If you’re a strong closer who thrives on turning conversations into revenue, this role is for you.</p> <p>We’re hiring an Inbound Sales Representative whose primary goal is simple: Convert as many inbound calls as possible into booked jobs—on the first call.</p> <p>You’ll be the voice of our company and the driving force behind turning customer inquiries into scheduled appointments.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Answer inbound calls and guide customers to book services in real time</li> <li>Take full ownership of each call—from inquiry to closed booking</li> <li>Ask smart, targeted questions to quickly understand customer needs</li> <li>Clearly relay our internal script for onsite estimates, using this as your tool to convert.</li> <li>Overcome objections and confidently close</li> <li>Schedule jobs accurately using CRM and dispatch software</li> <li>Coordinate with operations teams to ensure smooth execution</li> <li>Follow up on missed opportunities to capture additional revenue</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in inbound sales, call center sales, or high-conversion roles</li> <li>Strong closing skills—you’re comfortable asking for the sale</li> <li>Confident and professional phone presence</li> <li>Ability to think on your feet and handle objections effectively</li> <li>Highly organized and tech-savvy (CRM experience preferred)</li> <li>Driven by performance, metrics, and results</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in home services, moving, or logistics</li> <li>Track record of meeting or exceeding conversion or sales targets</li> <li>Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-volume call environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>$25-$28/hr based on experience</li> <li>Performance-based bonuses tied to conversion and bookings</li> <li>Growth opportunities as we expand across California</li> <li>Supportive, team-oriented environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us</strong></p> <p>At Vets Move Junk, your performance directly impacts company growth. Every call is an opportunity—and you’ll have the tools and support to succeed.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by results and enjoy closing deals, we want to hear from you.</p> </div> </div> <div
